title: वानीरा गिरिका कवितामा वरणस्वतन्त्रता (Freedom of Choice in Banira Giri’s Poems)
nepali: प्रस्तुत अध्ययन वानीरा गिरिका कवितामा अस्तित्ववाद तथा त्यससम्बद्ध वरणस्वतन्त्रताको विश्लेषणमा केन्द्रित छ। नेपाली नारी साहित्यमा वानीरा गिरि आख्यान, कविता, निबन्ध र नियात्रा लेखनका लागि परिचित नाम हो भने उनको मुख्य साहित्यिक प्रवृत्ति अस्तित्ववादी दर्शनको प्रस्तुति हो । मानवजीवनलाई व्यक्तिगत अस्तित्वको अर्थमा, जीवनको व्यक्तिगत अनुभवका आधारमा मात्र बुझ्न सकिन्छ भन्ने सन्दर्भबाट नामकरण र दार्शनिक आधार प्राप्त मान्छेको मूलसमस्या पहिल्याउनु र त्यसैको परिप्रेक्ष्यमा जीवनको सत्य खुट्याउने अस्तित्ववाद मानवदर्शन हो । अस्तित्ववादले व्यक्तिलाई सम्पूर्ण भ्रमबाट मुक्त पारी भ्रममुक्त भएको एउटा शून्यको बिन्दुबाट आफूलाई खोज्ने र आफ्नै प्रयासले आफूलाई चिन्ने र प्राप्त गर्ने आत्मविश्वास व्यक्तिभित्र जगाई जीवनको निस्सारता, निरर्थकता, निरूपायता, अनिश्चितता र विवशताको बोधबाट उत्पन्न नैराश्य र व्यक्तिप्रति स्वयम्लाई उत्तरदायी बनाउने विषय अस्तित्ववादको सैद्धान्तिक स्रोत हो भने व्यक्तिमहत्त्व यसको विश्लेषणीय पक्ष हो । प्रस्तुत सैद्धान्तिक आधारअन्तर्गत वरणस्वतन्त्रता यस अध्ययनको विश्लेष्य पक्ष हो भने चयनको अभिव्यक्ति, व्यक्तिसत्ता र उत्तरदायित्व विश्लेषण ढाँचा हो । गिरिका कवितामा वरणस्वतन्त्रताको अभिव्यञ्जना सशक्त रूपमा भएको छ । व्यक्तिको पहिचान अन्यव्यक्ति तथा समाजका सापेक्षमा स्थापित हुनका लागि उसको चयन नै शक्तिशाली रहने विषयका साथै व्यक्ति रहेकै कारण स्वयम्को अस्तित्व सार्थक रहने धारणामा व्यक्तिसत्ता प्रबल रहेको छ भने व्यक्तिले स्वतन्त्रतावरणको निर्णयको भागीदार हुनुपर्दाको क्षण तथा त्यसको उत्तरदायित्वका लागि तयार मानसिकताको चित्रण सशक्त प्रवाहित रहेको निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: This study focuses on an analysis of existentialism and the freedom of choice bound up with it in Banira Giri's poems. In Nepali women's literature Banira Giri is a familiar name for fiction, poetry, essays and travel writing, and her principal literary tendency is the presentation of existentialist philosophy. Existentialism is a philosophy of the human being that takes its name and its philosophical grounding from the premise that human life can be understood only in the sense of individual existence and on the basis of the individual's own experience of life; it identifies the fundamental problem of the human being and fixes the truth of life from that very perspective. Existentialism frees the individual from all illusion and plants within the individual the confidence to look for himself from a point of zero that is free of illusion and to know and attain himself through his own effort; its theoretical source is the despair born of the awareness of life's emptiness, meaninglessness, hopelessness, uncertainty and powerlessness, together with the matter of holding oneself answerable to the individual, while the worth of the individual is its analytic side. Within this theoretical basis, freedom of choice is the analytic aspect of this study, while the expression of choice, individual existence and responsibility constitute the analytic framework. In Giri's poems freedom of choice is expressed powerfully. It is concluded that his choice remains powerful for establishing the individual's identity in relation to other individuals and society; that individual existence stands out in the view that one's own existence is meaningful for the very reason that the individual exists; and that the portrayal of the moment at which the individual must become a partner in decisions within the sphere of freedom, and of a mind made ready to bear responsibility for them, flows powerfully.

informal_english: This study zeroes in on existentialism in Banira Giri's poems, and the freedom of choice that goes with it, hey. In Nepali women's writing Banira Giri is a name people know for fiction, poetry, essays and travel pieces, and her main literary thing is putting existentialist philosophy out there. Existentialism is a human philosophy that gets its name and its philosophical footing from the idea that you can only make sense of human life in terms of individual existence and on the basis of your own lived experience; it is about pinning down a person's core problem and working out life's truth from that very angle. What existentialism does is free you from every illusion and plant in you the confidence to go looking for yourself from a zero point with no illusions attached, and to get to know and reach yourself on your own steam; its theoretical source is the despair that comes from clocking life's emptiness, meaninglessness, hopelessness, uncertainty and helplessness, plus the business of being answerable to yourself, while the worth of the individual is its analytical side. Inside this theoretical setup, freedom of choice is the analytical angle of the study, while the expression of choice, individual existence and responsibility make up the analytical framework. Giri's poems put freedom of choice across powerfully, no doubt. The conclusion drawn is that your choice stays powerful when it comes to staking out your identity among other people and in society; that individual existence is front and centre in the view that your own existence matters for the simple reason that you exist; and that the picture of the moment when you have to be a partner in decisions inside the space of freedom, and of a mindset ready to take responsibility for them, comes through strongly.
translator_notes: Seven sentences in the source; order preserved across all variants. 'वरणस्वतन्त्रता' rendered as freedom of choice throughout. 'व्यक्तिमहत्त्व' taken as the worth/importance of the individual (its analytical side); 'व्यक्तिप्रति स्वयम्लाई उत्तरदायी बनाउने विषय' rendered literally as the matter of making oneself answerable to the individual. Informal flavour: South African casual.
